sentences.en: My children make pathetically sincere efforts to get up early.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们可怜兮兮地努力早点起床。

sentences.en: I'm being sincere when I say that I love you.
sentences.zh: 我说的话都是真心的，我爱你。

sentences.en: Instead of flattery, give us an honest and sincere estimate!
sentences.zh: 别再奉承我们了，给我们一个诚实而真诚的评估吧！

senses.zh: 诚实的，正直的；真挚的，纯净的
